text:
deploy-bot: Deploy v3.5.0-rollup -> global finished. Starting post-deploy smoke (8 probes) https://deploys.redwood/status/1781234567 :rocket:
samira: 2/8 probes failing: /tokenize returning 400 on UTF-8 payloads with emojis, and /stream returning broken chunk frames (client sees \"incomplete UTF-8 sequence\")
toni: hmm, tokenizer error looks like decode/regression. example curl:```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/tokenize -d '{\"text\": \"I love 🦊 and café\"}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json'
# response: 400 {"error":"invalid UTF-8 sequence at offset 7"}```
sre-lee: checking host pools for tokenizer service in us-east-1, us-west-2. no pod OOMs, but noticed a config map update for ICU locales rolled out in this deploy
samira: ICU change was part of v3.5 locale-opti PR. Might have altered normalization behavior causing strict decoder to reject certain sequences
zach: streaming proxy (edge-proxy v2.1.1) also got a minor bump in v3.5 and shows chunk-boundary rewrites in logs. Could explain stream frame chops
samira: proposal: soft-pin tokenizer service to v3.4.2 in us-* regions (route-level pin) and rollback edge-proxy in traffic-shim to v2.1.0 for streaming routes. That avoids full rollback of model server
sre-lee: applying route pin for /tokenize: 100% -> tokenizer:v3.4.2 in us-east/us-west. rolling proxy change in staging first then prod behind flag
release-coordinator: filed RN-5602: \"postdeploy: tokenizer decoding regression & stream chunking after locale/proxy changes (v3.5.0)\". Owner: intl-platform. Triage EOD
samira: re-run smoke: 8/8 pass after pin + proxy rollback in prod-canary. Tokenize returns 200, streaming frames intact :white_check_mark:
zach: leaving soft-hold for 30m. If anything else pops up we'll consider a full release rollback. Thanks team
deploy-bot: postdeploy smoke final: 8/8 pass. Actions: pinned tokenizer -> v3.4.2 (us regions), staged proxy rollback to v2.1.0 for streaming routes, RN-5602 created. :thumbsup:
